content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 06-11-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RGNAU to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RGNAU Non-Teaching Technical Personnel posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the RGNAU Non-Teaching Technical Personnel posts is 06 November 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Server Engineer post?
faq.answer: For the Server Engineer position, candidates need a First Class in B.E./B.Tech/MCA/M.Sc. (or equivalent) in Computer Science & Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline. A desirable qualification is M.E./M.Tech.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised Non-Teaching Technical Personnel posts is 35 years. Please refer to the official notification for any age relaxation details.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC(NCL)/EWS category candidates is Rs. 1000/-. SC/ST/PwD candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will involve a written test, trade test, and/or an interview, as decided by the university.

faq.question: Q6. Can candidates from outside Uttar Pradesh apply?
faq.answer: The notification indicates the university is located in Uttar Pradesh. While not explicitly stated, candidates from all eligible backgrounds can apply online, provided they meet the criteria.

faq.question: Q7. What is the nature of the employment for these posts?
faq.answer: The Non-Teaching Technical Personnel posts at RGNAU are on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary range for the Full Stack Developer role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Full Stack Developer position ranges from Rs. 40,000 to Rs. 60,000 per month, based on the candidate's experience.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is recommended to download and read it thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any experience required for the Computer Lab Engineer post?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of 1 year of relevant work experience in computer laboratory management or IT support is required for the Computer Lab Engineer position.
